response.sql: WITH grp AS (SELECT COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status') AS rfistat, AVG(modindex) AS avg_mod FROM signals GROUP BY COALESCE(rfistat, 'No Status')), base AS (SELECT AVG(modindex) AS baseline FROM signals), kept AS (SELECT g.rfistat, g.avg_mod, b.baseline FROM grp g CROSS JOIN base b WHERE g.avg_mod > b.baseline) SELECT rfistat, avg_mod AS avg_modindex, avg_mod - baseline AS diff_above_baseline, avg_mod - AVG(avg_mod) OVER () AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept

assumptions.assumption: Null rfistat values form their own group labeled 'No Status'; empty strings are treated as real statuses, not missing.
The baseline is the average modindex over all signals, ignoring null modindex values (each signal counted once, so not the mean of group averages).
Groups whose modindex is entirely null have a null average and are dropped by the above-baseline filter.
